**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Miss Poole](../persons.html#1187)[^2]
I suspected that you would have to change to Monday. I wonder if the enclosed will make any further change.

We shall be very glad to have you here on Sunday, and the carriage with [Miss Mackenzie](../persons.html#930) in it will meet you at Bpstoke at the same time.
I suppose - as you do not say so - [Miss Dyson](../persons.html#464) has heard no more from Heaths Court[^3]

yours affectionately

C M Yonge

[^1]: Endorsed in pencil ‘Aug. 1873/ authoress’.

[^2]: Presumed to be addressed to Harriet Poole, governess and sister of the Gosling Alice Poole.

[^3]: Heath\'s Court was the home of Sir [John Taylor Coleridge](../persons.html#344).
